result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **1Password or Bitwarden**\.

The choice comes down to whether you prioritize ease of use or affordability.

## My top 4 picks

![1Password: Password Manager | Apps | Godly](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/9Onad3ZmM68M7l5dTIbPMn43a-YB12X_e9tFS-w_jdjYbB1mwCcSBgDwHjfxiov3sFv56iK_BYB0DBDy1ElBpKTj_x8BM6wjwBy4mijsixFzsgcbh4l6IAVcN_W3xEYaPv3HJbWtjoYtl68hPIh1Q4uMTSZR5QKnTsp4CKPumigoRyeUfSzM6z8piMAIIqVa?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password Business**

(Best overall for ease of use)

# \$8.99

Per user/month, annual billing

- Excellent shared vaults and permissions.
- Easy onboarding and offboarding.
- Strong admin controls and security reporting.
- Great user experience across devices.

Website: [1Password Business](https://1password.com/business)

---

![Free High-Quality Bitwarden Logo for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/p0IJzf2NCUQ2t02rqtPWDpe7Tx4YGCRNleASv1NjpztaDI--7OD-0zWJhdBi_4Wn4-v0Hr3hoS6JA2KXHdCOlvvdfHelZm6tTBmFuxgAbBftLkdqobRCpEkp4ysyI4Rm6vafJPMfHi8ri9Tdeng_QKXRw7C7a5ESA6hn8XLhRMLnvM7oFmwZESsO4_SFLJaX?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden Teams**

(Best value)

# \$4

Per user/month, annual billing

- Open-source foundation.
- Shared collections and organization management.
- Audit logs and directory synchronization.
- Option to self-host.

Website: [Bitwarden Business](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper**

(Best for administration)

# \$2+

Per user/month, annual billing; entry plan

- Centralized admin console.
- Shared folders and access management.
- Good security and compliance options.
- More advanced capabilities on higher tiers.

Website: [Keeper Business](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![Password Manager App for Home, Mobile, Business | Dashlane](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/BEbD9DeZflKN6OjmxecA_3TWYXDWKAoFfMnSAgCLaHAzjsFDXRil4LkktJtGwo8UPVZqe2_Yh6dxGlaMnL2eRrZbxj8Tfmy2QNmfU5l5HhatwHS93Q_-GVArMyT9XEKGUMrZnYUANe-2lURPfPDCbuhB2uHjgVpobItIvecDhuvTtNaHK24ojgrSozPqNra2?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Dashlane**

(Best for security monitoring)

# \$8

Per user/month, published annual equivalent

- Password health monitoring.
- Phishing protection features.
- Admin controls and reporting.
- Useful security insights.

Website: [Dashlane Business](https://www.dashlane.com/business)

Pricing is indicative of published November 2026 pricing; verify current checkout prices and plan features. ## What I'd choose

| Your priority | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| Best overall experience | 1Password |
| Lowest cost with good features | Bitwarden |
| Advanced access administration | Keeper |
| Security monitoring | Dashlane |

2–5
